# IELTS Writing

## Core concept
IELTS Writing includes two tasks with different purposes and assessment criteria.

## How it works
Plan a clear position, organize paragraphs logically, and support claims with examples.

## What to watch out for
Leave time to check verb agreement, spelling, and whether every part of the task is answered.

## Worked example
For an opinion essay: state your view, explain two reasons, then summarize the position.

## Try it yourself
Write a new example using the rule and explain why it works.
